Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added a Move to waiting position button using the captured exterior coordinate and vnavmesh, with live distance and a stop control. Prize Fulfilment can now continue when only some prizes are prepared; missing or out-of-stock prizes remain awaiting and are excluded from winner recognition. Production-changing delivery actions remain locked for validation.
